test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 14 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25 and 26 are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown here. Find the number on the face opposite 21. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/74bef9f06a193e8c84e4d2a6c23f926cabe12ddc8d0afabdfcf991ad9010eea1.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '21', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43f4765d65fcb9376935e55354f8d8c9b9d9a5103bfccc52e174b7f06c3a290b.png] 

From both dices, 23 and 26 are common. So, remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

So, 24 will be opposite to 21.

Hence, the correct answer is "24".
